i64 modexp(i64 b, int e, int m) {
    i64 r = 1;
    while (e) {
        if (e & 1) r = r * b % m;
        b = b * b % m;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

int main() {
    int n, k, MOD;
    input(n); input(k); input(MOD);
    
    if (n & 1) {
        cout << modexp(k, n, MOD) << '\n';
        return 0;
    }
    
    vector<i64> fact(n + 1), inv_fact(n + 1);
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) fact[i] = fact[i-1] * i % MOD;
    inv_fact[n] = modexp(fact[n], MOD - 2, MOD);
    for (int i = n; i > 0; --i) inv_fact[i-1] = inv_fact[i] * i % MOD;
    
    vector<int> powers;
    int t = n;
    for (int i = 0; i <= 20; ++i) {
        if (t & 1) powers.emplace_back(1 << i);
        t >>= 1;
    }
    
    int size_mask = powers.size();
    int N = 1 << size_mask;
    vector<int> subset_sum(N);
    for (int mask = 0; mask < N; ++mask) {
        for (int j = 0; j < size_mask; ++j)
            if (mask >> j & 1) subset_sum[mask] += powers[j];
    }
    
    vector<int> next_mask(N);
    for (int mask = 0; mask < N; ++mask) {
        int bit = -1;
        for (int j = 0; j <= 20; ++j)
            if (mask >> j & 1) bit = j;
        next_mask[mask] = (1 << (bit + 1)) + mask;
    }
    
    vector<vector<i64>> dp(k + 1, vector<i64>(N));
    dp[0][0] = 1;
    
    for (int step = 0; step < k; ++step) {
        for (int mask = 0; mask < N; ++mask) {
            if (!dp[step][mask]) continue;
            for (int next = next_mask[mask]; next < N; next = (next + 1) | mask)
                dp[step + 1][next] = (dp[step + 1][next] + dp[step][mask] * inv_fact[subset_sum[next ^ mask]]) % MOD;
        }
    }
    
    i64 result = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= k; ++i) {
        result = (result + dp[i][N - 1] * fact[k] % MOD * inv_fact[k - i] % MOD) % MOD;
    }
    result = result * fact[n] % MOD;
    result = (modexp(k, n, MOD) - result + MOD) % MOD;
    
    cout << result << '\n';
    return 0;
}
